overall_summary: The performance data is extremely limited, with all three recent videos receiving negligible views (4-12 views) and zero engagement. Confidence is very low, requiring a controlled exploration phase to test basic hook traction.

winning_patterns.evidence: All videos have virtually zero views and engagement.
winning_patterns.action: Shift focus to testing completely fresh, sensory-based hooks.

weak_patterns.evidence: Hooks like 'नंबर ब्लॉक नहीं किया कभी' and 'मेज पर रखी चाय ठंडी हो गई' yielded under 15 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid cliché digital-age heartbreak tropes for the next test.
